tts: This program makes the release decision for three batches of tablets.
import csv loads the CSV module.
These two lines save the lab's results as qc dot csv: a header and three batches. In real life this file would come from the lab.
total will count the batches. It starts at zero.
failed will collect the numbers of the batches that fail.
DictReader gives one batch at a time. The first is B one oh one.
total goes up to one.
The assay and the dissolution are text in the file, so float turns them into numbers: ninety nine point two, and ninety two.
This is the specification. The batch fails if the assay is outside ninety five to one hundred and five, or if less than eighty percent dissolves. B one oh one passes both tests.
B one oh two has an assay of ninety four point one, below the limit, so it is added to failed.
B one oh three has a good assay, but only seventy six percent dissolves. It fails too.
print lists the failed batches.
Three batches minus two failures: one batch can be released.

tts: ಈ program tablets ನ ಮೂರು batches ಗೆ release ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ.
import csv, CSV module load ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ.
ಈ ಎರಡು lines lab ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು qc dot csv ಆಗಿ save ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ: ಒಂದು header ಮತ್ತು ಮೂರು batches. ನಿಜ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಈ file lab ಇಂದ ಬರುತ್ತೆ.
total batches ಎಣಿಸುತ್ತೆ. ಇದು zero ಇಂದ ಶುರು.
failed, fail ಆದ batches ನ numbers ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತೆ.

total ಒಂದು ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.

ಇದು specification. Assay ತೊಂಬತ್ತೈದು ಇಂದ ನೂರ ಐದು ಹೊರಗೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ, ಅಥವಾ ಎಂಬತ್ತು percent ಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಕರಗಿದರೆ batch fail. B one oh one ಎರಡೂ tests pass ಮಾಡುತ್ತೆ.
B one oh two ನ assay ತೊಂಬತ್ತನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಾಯಿಂಟ್ ಒಂದು, limit ಗಿಂತ ಕೆಳಗೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ failed ಗೆ ಸೇರುತ್ತೆ.

print fail ಆದ batches list ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತೆ.
ಮೂರು batches ಕಳೆ ಎರಡು failures: ಒಂದು batch release ಆಗಬಹುದು.

tts: The quality control results arrive as a CSV file: one row per batch, with its assay and its dissolution.
Step one: DictReader reads each row as a dictionary.
Step two: the values are text, so float turns them into numbers.
Step three: each batch is checked against the specification. B one oh two has an assay of ninety four point one, below ninety five, so it fails.
B one oh three dissolves only seventy six percent, below eighty. It fails too.
One batch can be released, and two are rejected. That is the release decision, made by your program.
